title: Leaf radio duty cycle under CSMA always-on (firmware-side energest) on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: CSMA baseline: node 1 = RPL root; node 2 = leaf. The default Contiki-NG CSMA keeps the radio in RX whenever not transmitting, so the LEAF's Radio Rx (idle-listening) duty cycle should be ~100% -- the always-on reference against which the TSCH duty cycle is compared. Passes once the leaf has printed >=2 period summaries.
